visualCharacteristics.purpose: Square image tiles in a wrapping 4-column grid

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) image; (2) optional caption
contentPattern.description: 8 square images in a wrapping 4-column grid — Repeating look-alike image tiles that flow and wrap in a grid
contentPattern.notes: One row per card. rc3: image-only cards (text cell empty/omitted); rc5: image + tag + date + H3 title linked to article

reuseGuidance: Use for image-only tiles. For tiles with tag/date/title linking to articles use cards-article.
